name: Controller boards
summary: Main control boards that run a machine: motor controllers, appliance boards and logic boards.
uses: Running a salvaged motor at variable speed (treadmill boards are prized)
Harvesting relays, regulators, MOSFETs and chips
Repairing a machine with a matching board
identify: The biggest board in an appliance, usually with relays, a microcontroller and plugs to every sensor and motor. Treadmill boards have big heatsinked MOSFETs or SCRs and drive 90–180V DC motors.
test: Look for burnt parts, bulged capacitors and cracked solder. Mains-fed boards can hold charge in big capacitors, so discharge them; then power up and check the 5V and 12V rails.

decay.note: Lasts dry; damp and corrosion kill boards.
